events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the day hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: It's 30 years since Tupac Shakur was shot. His music and impact continue to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away at the age of 27.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true guitar pioneer, Jimi Hendrix. His sound changed everything. What's his most iconic riff for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years of Abbey Road! That zebra crossing shot is arguably the most famous album cover ever. What's your top track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Rock Status
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the inimitable Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon with a voice that still commands attention. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Swagger
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't deny his rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and timeless album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. An album that still resonates with its message of peace and hope. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Announced 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket," revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: The iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple announced the device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! 64 years since Dr. No premiered. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album's Diversity
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Undying Legend
angles.copy: 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice, his showmanship – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! This album changed everything for them. What's your go-to track from this classic?
